# Populate DayQ World Content

Populate locations from function, history, ecology and current occupation—not interchangeable random loot.

Read [WORLD_POPULATION_CONTRACT.md](references/WORLD_POPULATION_CONTRACT.md). Inspect the region brief, DayQ timeline, content catalog, loot/scavenging/economy/AI/weather/building/persistence sheets, World Partition layout and performance budgets.

## Workflow

1. Define the location's pre-collapse function, collapse chronology, later occupants, damage, scavenging pressure, weather exposure and current strategic role.
2. Divide placement into structural kit, functional equipment, ordinary clutter, containers/contents, survival resources, evidence/story, hazards, AI/wildlife, traversal cover and dynamic events.
3. Select catalog families using contextual eligibility, scarcity, physical capacity, access route, ownership, prior depletion and economy rules.
4. Generate deterministic placement seeds and bounded variation. Preserve unique/story/strategic identities.
5. Validate physical fit, navigation, cover, line of sight, sound, traversal, hauling and interaction access.
6. Define depletion, player disturbance, respawn/replenishment, migration and offline simulation without reroll exploits.
7. Connect weather accumulation, decay, contamination, power/water and structural state through existing owners.
8. Assign World Partition cells, HLOD/instancing representation, relevance and persistence class.
9. Run plausibility, progression, economy, density, streaming, client/server and human readability tests.

## Completion

Deliver the location population manifest, causal history, catalog selections, placement rules/seeds, loot and population profiles, persistent/dynamic classifications, streaming budgets, validation route, evidence and unresolved authoring decisions.
